title: Form validation timing, error summary, and accessible field binding
iWant: mistakes pointed out early, precisely, and politely
soThat: I can fix problems where they are instead of hunting for them after a failed submit

acceptanceCriteria.description: Fields validate on blur; a field that failed once re-validates on change so corrections clear errors immediately.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a field with a validation rule
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user blurs with invalid content, then corrects it
acceptanceCriteria.then: the error appears on blur and clears as the correction is typed

acceptanceCriteria.description: Submitting with failures renders a submit-level summary listing every failed field, each entry a link that moves focus to its field.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a form with three invalid fields
acceptanceCriteria.then: a summary lists all three and each link focuses its field

acceptanceCriteria.description: Focus moves to the error summary on failed submit and the summary is announced assertively.
acceptanceCriteria.then: focus lands on the summary and it is announced

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every field error message is tied to its field via aria-describedby with aria-invalid set, and removed when resolved.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the message is associated and the state accurate through the fix

acceptanceCriteria.description: Required fields are marked visibly in the label and programmatically via required semantics; optionality is derivable without colour alone.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a form with required and optional fields
acceptanceCriteria.then: required marking is visible and programmatic

acceptanceCriteria.description: Personal-data fields carry correct autocomplete tokens (name, email, tel, and peers) and mobile-intent attributes (inputmode, type) matching the data.
acceptanceCriteria.when: field attributes are inspected on mobile
acceptanceCriteria.then: autofill offers correctly and the matching keyboard opens

acceptanceCriteria.description: Entered values survive a failed submit and a theme or locale switch; the form never clears user input on error.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a form with entered values and one invalid field
acceptanceCriteria.then: every entered value is still present
